purpose: Machine- and human-readable specification of per-session ordered-event predicate operations. Used when authoring hypotheses over parsed_traces (not raw logs). Evaluators read parsed_trace JSON directly; do not assume a normalized or flattened event representation.

session_document.description: One parsed session file under parsed_traces/<session_id>.json.

root_keys.Transcript: List of {user|bot: string} turn snippets; not used by ordered predicate ops (use ordered_events content instead).
root_keys.ordered_events: Time-ordered array; primary input for all four operations below.
root_keys.accumulated_events: Per-event-type metric lists; not used by these ordered ops (separate cohort metrics pipeline).

ordered_events_item_shape.rule: Each element is exactly one object with a single top-level key = event_type string.

ordered_event_types.description: Only these nine event types ever appear as keys in ordered_events (other allowed raw event types are accumulated-only in the parser).

payload_paths_for_predicates.event_value.agent_name: Skill/module name that produced the reply (string).

TOOL_CALL_RESULT.payload_shape: Object keyed by tool name (string). Each tool entry has tool_args (object) and result (object). Paths in meta_value_operation and is_ordered_seq_present must include the tool name as the first key after the event type.

DEBUG.TOOL_INVOKED.payload_shape: Object keyed by tool name. Each entry has input (object).

authoring_aids.deep_union_over_parsed_traces.json: Cohort-wide union of field values and tool names seen in ordered_events; use to pick valid tool names and nested result paths.
authoring_aids.va_blueprint.json: assistant_info from production blueprint (skills/tools); use for canonical tool and skill names when listing payment, auth, or domain tools.

hypothesis_structure.scope_predicate: Optional boolean expression; if false, session is excluded from eval (VALID_SKIP pattern).
hypothesis_structure.claim_predicate: Required boolean expression; outcome for included sessions.
hypothesis_structure.composition: Combine operations with and, or, not. No implicit OR across tools—list each tool explicitly or use helper lists in the hypothesis spec.

event_exists.description: True if at least one row in parsed_trace.ordered_events has the given event type as its sole top-level key.
semantics: Scan parsed_trace.ordered_events in array order; existence only—no payload inspection.
Does not distinguish tool names for TOOL_CALL_RESULT (any tool result counts).

examples.meaning: At least one successful tool execution was logged in ordered_events.
At least one LLM failure row exists.

meta_value_operation.description: True if ANY matching row in ordered_events satisfies a path predicate on that row's payload. Operates only on ordered_events—not accumulated_events.

path.structure: [event_type, k1, k2, ...] where event_type is the ordered_events key; k1,k2,... walk nested dict keys inside item[event_type].

value.description: Right-hand side for comparison ops; ignored when op is exists (may be null).

semantics: For each item in parsed_trace.ordered_events: if item does not contain path[0], skip.
Resolve payload = item[path[0]]; follow path[1..] through dict keys only.
If any key missing on a row, skip that row (do not treat as false for whole op until all rows exhausted).
op exists: True for that row if the full path resolves to any value (including scalar or nested object).
Other ops: leaf must be scalar (string, int, float, bool). Dict or list leaf → skip row.
Numeric: int values are coerced to float before ==, !=, <, <=, >, >=.
op in: value must be a list/set of scalars; True if leaf is in that set.
Match policy: ANY row matching → True; if no row matches → False.

examples.meaning: Some LLM success row was for purpose main_stream.
Some row contains a Make_CC_Payment tool result object (any args/result shape).

regex.description: True if the regex matches the content field of at least one user or bot turn in ordered_events.

pattern.description: Python regular expression passed to re.search (substring match, not full-string anchor unless ^ $ used).

semantics: user_turn: for each item with key USER_QUERY, test pattern against item.USER_QUERY.content if non-empty string.
bot_turn: for each item with key RESPONSE.FINAL, test pattern against item.RESPONSE.FINAL.content if non-empty string.
Skip missing content, non-strings, and empty strings.
ANY matching turn → True; else False.
Does not read Transcript or accumulated_events.

examples.meaning: User mentioned payment-related terms in at least one turn.
Bot claimed payment success or completion in at least one final response.

is_ordered_seq_present.description: True if a sequence of conditions matches in order within parsed_trace.ordered_events, with a moving start index (later steps only search after the prior match).

one_of.meaning: Next row (from current start index) whose sole key is event_type.
Same row must satisfy path predicate on item[event_type] with same rules as meta_value_operation (exists or scalar compare).

semantics: Let events = parsed_trace.ordered_events, start = 0.
For each seq in sequences: find smallest index j >= start such that events[j] matches seq; if none, return False; else start = j + 1.
All seq match → True.
event_type_only: events[j] is dict and event_type in events[j].
Path form: same matching as meta_value_operation but only on events[j] (single row), not ANY row.
TOOL_CALL_RESULT / DEBUG.TOOL_INVOKED: path keys after event_type begin with tool name.

examples.meaning: Authenticate_Customer result appears in the timeline before some later Make_CC_Payment result.
Some user query is followed later by some final response (weak ordering smoke test).

payment_hallucination_bot_success_no_pay.intent: Bot language claims payment success but no payment tool result appears in ordered_events.
payment_hallucination_bot_success_no_pay.notes: Replace tool names with names from va_blueprint.json and deep_union union.TOOL_CALL_RESULT keys.

auth_occurred_payment_tool_never_after_a.intent: Customer was authenticated via tool result, and no payment tool result appears after that auth row in the timeline.
auth_occurred_payment_tool_never_after_a.notes: Second conjunct fails if Make_CC_Payment appears anywhere after the first Authenticate_Customer match. Payment before auth does not satisfy the two-step seq.

evaluator_contract.output: boolean per operation; hypothesis combines with and/or/not
evaluator_contract.errors: Invalid event_type, unknown op, or malformed path should fail hypothesis validation at author time—not at per-session eval time when possible.
